summary: BazaarLink's free tier is an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway with 2 enabled free models — qwen/qwen3.7-flash and deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731free. Shared account allowance: 10 RPM + 60 weighted units/day without credit, 20 RPM + 120 weighted units/day with credit; counters reset at 00:00 UTC. No credit card required; 2 concurrent free requests per account. A site-wide 15 RPM free cap and additional IP guard also apply, even to credited accounts. After a free limit, paid fallback runs only when enabled for the key and the account has sufficient credit.
claim_steps: Sign up at bazaarlink.ai and create an API key — no credit card.
Set base_url to https://api.bazaarlink.ai/v1 in any OpenAI SDK.
Call one of the enabled free model ids, e.g. qwen/qwen3.7-flash; shared limits reset daily at 00:00 UTC.
Respect the site-wide 15 RPM free cap as well as account limits; keep paid fallback disabled for the key if you want only free usage.

social_proof.title: Free LLM API + Free AI API Key | 2 Models
social_proof.text: Site-wide free cap: 15 RPM. Concurrent free requests per account: 2. After a limit, paid use is possible only when fallback is enabled and the account has sufficient credit.
